sections.text: Introduction

This document 
outlines the testing procedure P1, which must performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

REC 920 is a steam turbine control 
and safety systems it contains the following subsystems:

Speed Control System, Vibration 
System, Safety System, PLC system, Load Control System, Gland Steam Control 
System, By Pass Control System

Components: 
 The 
speed control system consist of:

One Rack 
(9 cards):

- Two 
cards type AH112 - One card type AH113 - One card type AH111.

- One 
card type LV 110 - One card type MZ134 - Three cards type LV108
Three way servo valve.

The first draft 
initiated by eng. Gabre Ali Ramadan tested by, eng. Mostafa Ibrahim,Alaa 
ELshal, 
EDEPC 
revised by quality control eng. Abdel Menem ALEmam, accepted 
by general director eng. Fawzy Sobhy Esmaile, and approved by eng. Monir 
Elwakel Head Sector of Damietta CCPS, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy 
EDEPC head sector of inspection & quality control.
Safety Precautions
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety Helmet, safety shoes ...etc

items:
A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety Helmet, safety shoes ...etc
Unit in stand still.

When working on steam valves oil circuit ensure that no one is working on the 
 components of control oil system as valves, pipes, pumps, and so on by 
 coordinating with shift engineer.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Digital multi meter,
Wire connection
Contact cleaner

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Tighten all bolts and terminals.
Check the card according to the MRDS (1)

items: Clean all cards
Tighten all bolts and terminals.
Check the card according to the MRDS (1)
Calibrate the servo control valves according to the MRDS (2)

Simulate the following Signal 
 to make the system available.

Jumper X16(21&22) 
 to ensure that the lube oil 
 pressure is OK.

Jumper XX4(57&58) to 
 ensure that the vacuum condenser is OK.

Remove X16(97) 
 to ensure that the Processing failure is OK.
Put the control oil pump in operation

Inject the signal to the card LV108 
 and check the reading according to the MRDS (2).

Remove 
 all jumpers
Stop the control oil pump
Close the work order.

Introduction
This document 
outlines the testing procedure P1, which must performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.
REC 920 is a steam turbine control 
and safety systems it contains the following subsystems:
Speed Control System, Vibration 
System, Safety System, PLC system, Load Control System, Gland Steam Control 
System, By Pass Control System
Components: 
 The 
speed control system consist of:
One Rack 
(9 cards):
- Two 
cards type AH112 - One card type AH113 - One card type AH111.
- One 
card type LV 110 - One card type MZ134 - Three cards type LV108
Three way servo valve.
The first draft 
initiated by eng. Gabre Ali Ramadan tested by, eng. Mostafa Ibrahim,Alaa 
ELshal, 
EDEPC 
revised by quality control eng. Abdel Menem ALEmam, accepted 
by general director eng. Fawzy Sobhy Esmaile, and approved by eng. Monir 
Elwakel Head Sector of Damietta CCPS, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy 
EDEPC head sector of inspection & quality control.
Safety Precautions
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety Helmet, safety shoes ...etc
A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety Helmet, safety shoes ...etc
Unit in stand still.
When working on steam valves oil circuit ensure that no one is working on the 
 components of control oil system as valves, pipes, pumps, and so on by 
 coordinating with shift engineer.
Tools and Equipment
Digital multi meter,
Wire connection
Contact cleaner
Work to be Carried Out
Tighten all bolts and terminals.
Check the card according to the MRDS (1)
Clean all cards
Tighten all bolts and terminals.
Check the card according to the MRDS (1)
Calibrate the servo control valves according to the MRDS (2)
Simulate the following Signal 
 to make the system available.
Jumper X16(21&22) 
 to ensure that the lube oil 
 pressure is OK.
Jumper XX4(57&58) to 
 ensure that the vacuum condenser is OK.
Remove X16(97) 
 to ensure that the Processing failure is OK.
Put the control oil pump in operation
Inject the signal to the card LV108 
 and check the reading according to the MRDS (2).
Remove 
 all jumpers
Stop the control oil pump
Close the work order.
